question: Which frozen weight-defined reader modes are occupied by the confirmed four-head intervention on v23, and how much of each early head's literal direct-to-M11 capability survives intervening nonlinear transport?
evidence_status: Prospective activation-occupancy overlay. The weight tensor is open and diffuse with shared factor support but head-private signed maps. No projection of v23 activations or singleton causal responses into its frozen modes has been opened.

frozen_design.weight_coordinates: SVD the frozen C[h,a,i,k] reader-mode unfolding only to obtain a 4x4 orthogonal coordinate change. This is computed exclusively from weights and is not refit on activations.
frozen_design.native_occupancy: Capture base/donor c_proj input coordinates z_h and M11 inputs x on all 64 aligned v23 rows. For each position, contract the frozen C/S tensors with base x and delta-z to obtain the literal direct-interface prediction in frozen reader coordinates.
frozen_design.realized_transport: Run the four frozen singleton donor patches and project their actual M11 hidden-factor changes into the same reader basis and reader-mode coordinates. L11H3 crosses the live post-attention RMS normalization but no later transformer block; L8H1/L9H1/L9H4 additionally cross intervening blocks.
frozen_design.aggregation: Report target jointly-capable rows, P, and C separately; both frozen reporter halves separately; every head separately; and the four-head sum as a diagnostic. No PCA, SAE, rotation, route selection, threshold tuning, or parameter fit occurs.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_hooks_self_ca: All hashes, population, hook coverage, four-head self-patch no-op, finiteness, and seven-forward price pass.
predictions.pred_b_adjacent_L11H3_preserves_direct_w: Despite live RMS normalization, the literal direct-interface tensor predicts actual L11H3 M11 factor-response orientation at cosine >=0.70; scale residual is diagnostic and is not a closure bar.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_two_early_heads_preserve: At least two of L8H1/L9H1/L9H4 have target direct-prediction versus realized-response cosine >=0.70.
predictions.pred_d_realized_target_use_is_sparser_an: At least 60% of realized target response energy occupies one frozen reader mode and the two reporter halves' four-mode energy profiles have cosine >=0.90.

opposing_interpretations.direct_transport: B-D pass: the globally diffuse tensor is selectively occupied and head writes largely retain their literal orientation through normalization and the residual path.
opposing_interpretations.nonlinear_transport: B passes and C fails: normalization preserves adjacent orientation, but early-head computation must include intervening blocks as a transport tensor/Jacobian rather than folding W_O directly into M11. B failure means even the adjacent interface requires an explicit normalization transport.
opposing_interpretations.occupancy_not_sparse: D fails: the observed task also uses multiple weight modes; do not force an SAE/hierarchy merely because the circuit is selective.
opposing_interpretations.invalid: Only A failure invalidates the capture instrument. B/C are substantive transport outcomes.

decision: Use the outcome to choose between a direct restricted-weight circuit and an explicit head-to-M11 transport tensor. Any later SAE or hierarchical decomposition is an occupancy annotation and must preserve the frozen weight coordinates.
